issue_context.title: describe leads to thread '<unnamed>' panicked at not implemented for dtype Object
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

data = {
    'object': pl.Series([{'a': 1, 'b': 2}, {'a': 3, 'b': 4}, {'a': 5, 'b': 6}], dtype=pl.Object)
}
df = pl.DataFrame(data)

df.describe(percentiles=(0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95))
```


### Issue description

Having a `pl.Object` column prevents other column from being described by throwing an exception:
```
File ~\DataspellProjects\polars-test-template\lib\site-packages\polars\lazyframe\frame.py:1508, in LazyFrame.collect(self, type_coercion, predicate_pushdown, projection_pushdown, simplify_expression, no_optimization, slice_pushdown, common_subplan_elimination, streaming)
   1497     common_subplan_elimination = False
   1499 ldf = self._ldf.optimization_toggle(
   1500     type_coercion,
   1501     predicate_pushdown,
   (...)
   1506     streaming,
   1507 )
-> 1508 return wrap_df(ldf.collect())

PanicException: not implemented for dtype Object("object")
```

### Expected behavior

`describe` works for other dataframe columns
